dedupe_keys.name: inem pre hospital emergency activity portugal sns transparency daily dispatches by resource type daily calls by priority and monthly occurrences by type

description: These datasets record the daily and monthly workload of Portugal's national pre-hospital emergency medical service, from the emergency calls it triages to the ambulances, cars and helicopters it sends. They are produced by INEM, the National Institute of Medical Emergency, and published on the SNS Transparency portal. One series counts dispatches every day since November 2016 for each type of resource, including emergency helicopters, medical emergency cars, life support and emergency ambulances, motorcycles and rescue ambulances based at partner posts. A second counts calls every day by clinical priority, with the target arrival time for each level, such as 18 minutes for priority 2. A third gives monthly occurrences since 2013 in 36 categories such as road accidents, cardiac arrest, trauma, breathing difficulty, childbirth and psychiatric emergencies, and a fourth covers medical advice to vessels at sea. All are free and available to download in CSV, JSON, Excel and Parquet, and through the portal API. Caveats: the series are national totals without location, actual response times are not published here, and the type list includes a COVID category, so category definitions should be checked over time. Simulation uses: setting daily EMS demand and fleet mix in ambulance deployment models, and measuring surges during heatwaves, epidemics or major incidents. Related records: the SNS emergency department data (data-sns-portugal-emergency-department-attendances) show where patients arrive, and the Ambulance Victoria statistics (data-ambulance-victoria-incident-statistics) are a comparable EMS source.
name: INEM pre-hospital emergency activity (Portugal, SNS Transparency): daily dispatches by resource type, daily calls by priority and monthly occurrences by type
provider: Instituto Nacional de Emergência Médica (INEM), Portugal, published on the SNS Transparency portal
schema_summary: Dispatches (daily): number of activations of the emergency medical helicopter service (SHEM), medical emergency and resuscitation cars (VMER), paediatric inter-hospital transport ambulances (TIP), immediate life support ambulances (SIV), emergency medical ambulances (AEM), emergency motorcycles (MEM), psychological intervention units (UMIPE), rescue ambulances at emergency posts (PEM), at reserve posts (RES) and at non-INEM posts (NINEM). Priority (daily): occurrences by priority 1 to 5 and non-urgent without dispatch, with target arrival times (P2 18 minutes, P3 60 minutes, P4 120 minutes). Type (monthly): occurrences in 36 categories (road accident, cardiac arrest, trauma, dyspnoea, chest pain, psychiatric, childbirth, intoxication, secondary transport, COVID and others). CODU MAR: monthly medical advice calls from vessels
